name: OFF
purpose: LED fully off. Push default index 0, never overwritten.

name: FX_OFF
purpose: FX present, opacity 0 - the pad is loaded and ready

name: FX_MID
purpose: FX present, opacity between 0 and on_value, or mid-ramp

name: FX_ON
purpose: FX present, opacity at or above on_value

name: FX_BYPASSED
purpose: FX present but hard-bypassed out of the render chain
